answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's rewards sit in an onyx-hard escrow for 26 epochs, and any peer can open a challenge proving the account graded colluding answers or reused text; if upheld, the escrow is clawed back. A swarm that streaks in like a comet to farm rewards finds no quick haven to cash out, so every fake identity must stay live, keep doing verified work and risk its locked stake for weeks, multiplying the attacker's capital and compute costs.
